title: Two killed in Leeds after car pursued by police crashes into another vehicle
summary_full: Four arrested after BMW collides with Volkswagen on Gelderd Road, with police appealing for witnessesTwo people aged 22 and 23 have died after their car was hit by a BMW being pursued by police.West Yorkshire police said four people had been arrested after the crash in Leeds on Sunday and appealed for witnesses to come forward.
